## `drive_access_proposal_list`

Class: read

List pending "Request access" proposals on a file. Useful for programmatic triage of share requests from external collaborators.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `account` | string | optional | Google account alias; "*" = all accounts; omit for the default account |
| `fileId` | string | required | Google Drive file ID |
| `pageSize` | number | optional |  |
| `pageToken` | string | optional |  |

## `drive_access_proposal_resolve`

Class: update

Resolve a pending access proposal. Action ACCEPT requires a role array (e.g. ["reader"]).

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `account` | string | optional | Google account alias |
| `fileId` | string | required | Google Drive file ID |
| `proposalId` | string | required | Access proposal ID |
| `action` | enum | required | Whether to accept or deny the proposal |
| `role` | array | optional | Required when action is ACCEPT |
| `view` | string | optional | Optional view, e.g. "published" |
| `sendNotification` | boolean | optional | Email the requester about the resolution |

## `drive_comment_create`

Class: create

Create a comment on a Drive file. Works on Docs, Sheets, Slides, PDFs, and any Drive file. The optional anchor is a JSON string describing the document region (see Drive "Manage comments" guide).

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `account` | string | optional | Google account alias |
| `fileId` | string | required | Google Drive file ID |
| `content` | string | required | Plain text comment content |
| `anchor` | string | optional | Region anchor (JSON string). Optional. |
| `quotedFileContent` | object | optional | Optional reference to quoted file content |

Class: read

Download a binary file from Drive to local disk. For Google Workspace formats (Docs, Sheets, Slides), use drive_export instead.

|---|---|---|---|
| `account` | string | optional | Google account alias |
| `fileId` | string | required | Google Drive file ID |

The file name comes from `filename`. |
| `filename` | string | optional | Filename to save as (defaults to the file name in Drive) |

## `drive_export`

Class: read

Export a Google Workspace document (Doc, Sheet, Slide) to a standard format and save to disk. Supported: PDF, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, TXT, CSV, Markdown (text/markdown for Docs).

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `account` | string | optional | Google account alias |
| `fileId` | string | required | Google Drive file ID |
| `mimeType` | string | required | Target export MIME type (e.g. "application/pdf", "text/markdown", "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document") |
| `savePath` | string | required | Destination folder to save into, on the machine running the server: confined to GOOGLE_LOCAL_FILES_DIR (default <home>/Downloads/mcp-google-multi), created if missing; a relative path resolves inside it, an absolute path must already be inside it. The file name comes from `filename`. |
| `filename` | string | optional | Filename to save as (defaults to the Drive name plus the extension implied by mimeType) |

## `drive_permission_update`

Class: update

Change the role and/or expirationTime of an existing permission without removing it. Use "removeExpiration=true" to clear an existing expirationTime.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `account` | string | optional | Google account alias |
| `fileId` | string | required | Google Drive file ID |
| `permissionId` | string | required | Permission ID from drive_list_permissions |
| `role` | enum | optional | New role |
| `expirationTime` | string | optional | New RFC 3339 expiration timestamp. Only valid for role "reader" or "commenter". |
| `removeExpiration` | boolean | optional | Clear the existing expirationTime |
| `transferOwnership` | boolean | optional | Promote to owner. Requires role="owner". |

## `drive_read`

Class: read

Read the content of a Google Drive file: Workspace docs and textual types (text/*, JSON/XML/SVG and similar) inline; other binaries return error:binary (returns up to maxChars characters per call; non-Google-native files over 2MB return too_large)

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `account` | string | optional | Google account alias; "*" = all accounts; omit for the default account |
| `fileId` | string | required | Google Drive file ID |
| `maxChars` | number | optional | Max characters of content to return (default: 100000) |
| `offset` | number | optional | Character offset to continue a truncated read (Google Docs/Sheets/Slides exports page fine; plain files >2MB are rejected, not paged) |

## `drive_search`

Class: read

Search files in a Google Drive account. A plain keyword is treated as a full-text search; pass Drive query syntax for a structured search.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `account` | string | optional | Google account alias; "*" = all accounts; omit for the default account |
| `query` | string | required | A plain keyword (full-text search) or Drive query syntax, e.g. "name contains 'MoU'" |
| `maxResults` | number | optional | Max results to return (default: 10, max: 100) |
| `driveId` | string | optional | Optional shared drive ID |
| `pageToken` | string | optional | Continuation token from a previous call's nextPageToken |
| `orderBy` | string | optional | Sort key(s) for files.list, e.g. "modifiedTime desc" or "folder,name". Default: Drive's relevance ranking for the query, an arbitrary stable order otherwise. |

## `drive_transfer`

Class: create

Copy or move a file from one configured account to another (server-side share+copy, with a download+upload fallback). The copy is owned by the target account with a clean name (no "Copy of"); the temporary share on the source is revoked afterwards. Comments, revision history, and permissions do not transfer. move=true trashes the source after a successful copy and requires deletes to be allowed by write-control.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fromAccount` | string | required | Source account alias |
| `toAccount` | string | required | Target account alias |
| `fileId` | string | required | File ID in the source account (folders are not supported) |
| `parentFolderId` | string | optional | Target folder ID, not parentId. Default: target My Drive root |
| `newName` | string | optional | Rename the copy (default: keep the source name) |
| `move` | boolean | optional | Trash the source after a successful copy (delete-gated) |

## `drive_update`

Class: update

Rename, move, or replace content of a Drive file. Any combination in one call. For untrash, use drive_untrash.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `account` | string | optional | Google account alias |
| `fileId` | string | required | Google Drive file ID |
| `newName` | string | optional | New filename |
| `newParentFolderId` | string | optional | Move to this folder, named newParentFolderId here, not parentFolderId |
| `localPath` | string | optional | Replace file content with this local file, on the machine running the server: confined to GOOGLE_LOCAL_FILES_DIR (default <home>/Downloads/mcp-google-multi); a relative path resolves inside it, an absolute path must already be inside it. |
| `mimeType` | string | optional | MIME type of the replacement file (required if localPath is provided) |
| `convertTo` | enum | optional | When replacing content via localPath, convert the new content into this native Google Workspace type on import: "document" \| "spreadsheet" \| "presentation" \| "drawing" (full application/vnd.google-apps.* ids also accepted). |

## `drive_upload`

Class: create

Upload a file to Google Drive, from inline base64 content or (when this server exposes the host filesystem) a local path. Pass `convertTo` to import it as a native, editable Google Doc/Sheet/Slides/Drawing instead of storing the raw bytes.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `account` | string | optional | Google account alias |
| `filename` | string | required | Name as it appears in Drive |
| `contentBase64` | string | optional | Base64-encoded file content. Exactly one of contentBase64 or localPath is required. Decoded size is capped at 10 MB. |
| `localPath` | string | optional | Path of the SOURCE file to upload, on the machine running the server (this is not savePath): confined to GOOGLE_LOCAL_FILES_DIR (default <home>/Downloads/mcp-google-multi); a relative path resolves inside it, an absolute path must already be inside it. Exactly one of contentBase64 or localPath is required. |
| `mimeType` | string | optional | Source MIME type of the content (inferred from filename if omitted). With `convertTo`, this is the format Drive imports from. |
| `convertTo` | enum | optional | Convert the upload into this native Google Workspace type on import: "document" \| "spreadsheet" \| "presentation" \| "drawing" (full application/vnd.google-apps.* ids also accepted). E.g. upload .md/.html/.docx/.txt with convertTo=document to get a real Google Doc. Source must be an importable format. Omit to store the file as-is. |
| `parentFolderId` | string | optional | Parent folder ID, not parentId. Defaults to My Drive root |
